releasePlan.notes: Flag evaluates after await initLaunchDarkly() completes. control variation = pre-PR behaviour (title overlay shown directly, no callsign screen). v1 variation = new callsign login overlay shown first; ldClient.identify() retargets LD context to the player's callsign after login. loginOverlay HTML/CSS is always in the DOM but stays display:none under control — no flash. The loginForm submit listener is registered only in the v1 path. restartGame() guard (loginOverlay.style.display=none) is safe unconditionally. No prerequisite flags. Existing invaders-shooter-sprite flag is orthogonal and unaffected.
